	/* nova_ext_sim_central:sync_character_update v1 START - managed block, do not edit by hand */
	public function update_character($id = '', $data = '')
	{
		$result = parent::update_character($id, $data);

		// Change tracking for the REST API's ?updated_since. Re-reads and
		// re-hashes the stored row rather than trusting $data, so a rewrite
		// that changed nothing leaves content_updated_at where it was.
		if ($result > 0 && $id > 0 && class_exists('nova_ext_sim_central\\SyncTrack')) {
			\nova_ext_sim_central\SyncTrack::onCharacterChanged($id);
		}

		return $result;
	}
	/* nova_ext_sim_central:sync_character_update END */
